Info

Concrete implementation of C++ interface parser.

class gen_test.infrastructure.parser.cpp_parser.CppParser[source]¶

Bases: object

Concrete adapter parsing C++ interface header files into domain models.

It defines:

methods:
parse_file - Reads and parses a C++ header file.
parse_source - Parses raw C++ text.
is_initialized - Checks if parser is initialized.
__str__ - Returns string representation of parser.
_CLASS_RE: Pattern[str] = re.compile('(?:class|struct)\\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)(?:\\s*:\\s*public\\s+([A-Za-z0-9_:]+))?\\s*\\{([^}]*)\\};', re.DOTALL)¶
_COMMENT_RE: Pattern[str] = re.compile('//.*?$|/\\*.*?\\*/', re.MULTILINE|re.DOTALL)¶
_INCLUDE_RE: Pattern[str] = re.compile('^\\s*#include\\s+([<"][^>"]+[>"])', re.MULTILINE)¶
_NAMESPACE_RE: Pattern[str] = re.compile('namespace\\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_:]+)\\s*\\{')¶
_PURE_VIRTUAL_RE: Pattern[str] = re.compile('virtual\\s+([\\w\\s:*&<>]+?)\\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\\s*\\((.*?)\\)\\s*(const)?\\s*(noexcept)?\\s*=\\s*0\\s*;', re.MULTILINE)¶
_extract_methods(body: str) → list[CppMethod][source]¶

Extracts pure virtual methods from class body.

_extract_namespace(code: str) → str[source]¶

Extracts namespace definition from code, e.g. “acme::hardware”.

_parse_parameters(params_raw: str) → list[tuple[str, str]][source]¶

Parses raw parameter string into list of (type, name) tuples.

_split_parameters(params_raw: str) → list[str][source]¶

Splits parameter string respecting template angle brackets.

_strip_comments(code: str) → str[source]¶

Removes single-line and multi-line comments from C++ code.

is_initialized() → bool[source]¶

Checks if parser is initialized.

Returns:

True.
